notes.title: 6 Months Since the First Playable!
notes.notes:
The time has come to tell you a little bit about the origin of this game! 

As a lecturer of programming video games (in Unity), I like to set the expectations for the course early. That's why I love making games, uploading them, and then showing them as an example of what my course has to offer you.  And one of those projects just happened to be Arrowman! :)

[i]These are the games that my students create by the end of the course.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181369/c8efb2508b3d7612f6caac6cd0c476010cf845b4.png[/img]

Even though I have been working full time for almost 4 months now, it's been 6 months since the first playable of Arrowman. At first I wasn't sure if I wanted to continue working on it, but the more I improved on the prototype, it made sense to go into full production of the game. It all clicked when I made arrows stick into walls and then stand there as a platform for players to jump on. 

Now the game has changed quite a bit, and I still hope to improve a lot more! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181369/8e07a3296ee01b95d0d12cc59e47afcf019567d3.png[/img]

You might also be interested in seeing this prototype I mentioned, so [url=https://smokey72a.itch.io/machina-platformer]here[/url] it is, enjoy! ^^

I hope you have a nice day! :)

notes.title: Arrowman has a Coming Soon page!
notes.notes:
Hello ArrowPeople!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181369/4bed84972e755db50804f349c92489b823674b99.png[/img]

I am very excited to show you Arrowman, the game I have been solo developing, so please, welcome it on Steam! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181369/89a3d682e80a8f16af0213c4ba74c5c921d275c2.png[/img]

It’s a faced-paced adventure game set in the world filled with Nightmares. These creatures are making the world more hostile, so prepare for action!
Arrowman takes inspiration from combat focused games as well as from platformer metroidvanias, so expect a bit of both! This will be it for now, but expect more information about the game soon :)

See ya!
